simplification_review.finding: Headers were chosen for inexpensive, visible, independently configurable prototype settings. They are not all needed for CAN or programming.
simplification_review.recommended_direction: Retain a deliberate physical per-port power choice; evaluate compact input-mode switches to replace exposed bias and threshold headers.
simplification_review.limits: A switch replacement must preserve all input modes, have appropriate voltage/current ratings, and be checked for size, cost, footprint and interlock behavior. Firmware selection requires additional analog switching and control signals; it cannot replace these jumpers through firmware changes alone. No switch redesign is claimed in this review.
